name: button
description: A source-owned shadcn-style native button for Dioxus with typed variants and sizes.

documentation.compositionNote: Use caller-composed children for text, icons, and icon-plus-text content. `ButtonVariant` is a shape-only axis (Primary/Secondary/Outline/Ghost/Link) orthogonal to a separate `color: Tone` prop (Default/Success/Warning/Error/Info) -- upstream shadcn's Destructive is reached via `color: Tone::Error` on any shape rather than as its own shape value. `ButtonSize` mirrors the current shadcn visual contract; native Dioxus button/global attributes and events are forwarded.
documentation.accessibility: A native `<button>`; visible content is caller-composed through `children`, so text-only, icon-only, and icon-plus-text buttons all use the same accessible native control (`registry/ui/button.rs`). Icon-only usage should include an explicit `aria-label`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond native button activation (Enter/Space).
